title: Gulliver Preparatory Courtyard
address:
12595 Red Rd
Coral Gables, Florida 33165
United States
description:
The Goldstrich Family Courtyard at Gulliver Preparatory School's Marian C. Krutulis PK-8 Campus in Coral Gables was built as part of the school's centennial campaign, just outside the historic Manor House.

The courtyard now serves as the campus's main outdoor gathering space, connecting newer facilities like the LEED Silver-certified Center for Student Life.

The renovation scope included a screening system to block the view and noise of nearby HVAC equipment, ADA upgrades, and upgraded railings and lighting. Crews also rebuilt staircases and walkways, applied non-slip flooring in high-traffic areas, and renovated both group and individual restrooms.
